findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/worktree-ensure.ts::project setup scripts are only covered by the typescript pre-check
findings.title: Project setup scripts are only covered by the TypeScript pre-check
findings.action: Document that project scripts must use the flattened path, or verify the reported path after the script
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec 3.1 chooses the TypeScript pre-check plus the bundled script's own refusals; step 6's strictly-under-root assert still refuses an escaped worktree. Out of this ticket's scope.

occurrences.title: Project setup scripts are only covered by the TypeScript pre-check

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/worktree-ensure.ts::a script-side refusal surfaces as setup-failed, not setup-refused
findings.title: A script-side refusal surfaces as setup-failed, not setup-refused
findings.action: Map a refusal-pattern script exit to setup-refused
findings.disposition_rationale: Only reachable in the race window the spec puts out of scope; fail-closed either way and the branch name is in the setup log.

occurrences.title: A script-side refusal surfaces as setup-failed, not setup-refused

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff-graft/setup-worktree.sh::script-side ls-remote has no bound without timeout or gtimeout
findings.title: Script-side ls-remote has no bound without timeout or gtimeout
findings.action: Add a fallback bound or skip the script-side check
findings.disposition_rationale: The script's existing git fetch is equally unbounded on that host, so this adds no new class of hang; worktree ensure bounds its own call via gitNet.

occurrences.title: Script-side ls-remote has no bound without timeout or gtimeout

findings.title: worktree-root failure detail is discarded
findings.action: Capture the resolver's stderr and reword the empty-output case
findings.disposition_rationale: The refusal message and exit are exactly as specified in 3.3; richer diagnostics are an improvement for a follow-up.
